findings.why: This is the source shop's own news about its breeding trials, and the reader has no way of knowing who is running them or how they went.

sections.quickFacts:glaser: Asal: Sulawesi. Betina bisa mencapai 2 cm, sedangkan jantan tetap sedikit lebih kecil. Sejauh ini mudah dipelihara.
